title: stillingia treculiana
intro: Stillingia treculiana, commonly known as Queen's Delight, is a perennial plant native to the southeastern United States. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating various skin conditions, fever, and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Stillingia treculiana are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and fight infections, making it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include stilbenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential uses.
